meaning: Eliminate the realized-end witness using uniqueness of the effective action to derive performance. Independently check two inhabited two-action profiles with identical ends, effects and behavior, assigning and withholding a categorical-duty predicate. The successful goal does not supply a deontic bridge or any claim of actual objective duties.
